items.analysis: Sections is the actual subtype of equivariant right inverses of q. Exactness and injectivity construct a unique equivariant factor of a difference through i. coordinates and sectionTorsor give a genuine AddTorsor with the proved ambient formula t+i*u; coordinates_affine and coordinates_ternary preserve all scalar and additive affine structure, including characteristic two. The actual T transition is expressed as L*u+d with L=alpha postcomposition. Homogenization uses W_n times k, so finite-dimensional stabilization uses precisely W_n, not the ambient B_n. Actual composite ranges and intersections are transported through the bijective coordinate charts, and the actual stable-image transition is proved surjective. No arbitrary original transition is assumed surjective.

Finite C and every B_n imply finite-dimensional equivariant Hom spaces, which is the hypothesis used by coherent_sections; no averaging or invertible group-order assumption is used. The actual limit is the submodule of compatible coordinate families with coordinatewise action. record_coordinate proves q-infinity is the common C value; mapLimit_injective/exact prove the exact kernel description from the original i and alpha. splitEquiv is the actual map (a,c) -> i-infinity(a)+s-infinity(c), proved bijective, equivariant and compatible with inclusion and projection. Coordinate extraction and assembly are inverse, familyEquiv includes all coherent families, and all_limit_sections classifies all differences by the actual Hom_G(C,A-infinity). decomposition_classified recovers every required decomposition from its section. homEquiv/coherentSectionsEquiv implement b_n*s_n*d^-1, inverse, identity and composition; transport_translation gives the actual a_n*u_n*d^-1 parameter formula.

Only eventual bijectivity of the actual section transitions is assumed. EventualTower.extend descends along every earlier transition and then uses inverse choices in the bijective tail; coherence and evaluation injectivity are proved, without assuming early surjectivity or any finite-dimensionality. evalEquiv is evaluation at the specified N on actual families. The revised source proves actual ternary section/family operations s-r+t, their closure, and preservation by evaluation, inverse evaluation and parameterChart, in addition to all scalar binary affine combinations. Together these give the full affine structure over any field, including F2. parameterChart has domain exactly Hom_G(C,A_N), and unique_iff_direction_zero is both directions for this entire space, not the stronger A_N=0 condition.

coherent_sections_of_finite_parameters has only finite-dimensionality of the actual W_n=Hom_G(C,A_n); neither A_n nor B_n is assumed finite-dimensional. The coordinate affine tower gives actual coherent sections. full_split_finite_parameters constructs the same true limit decomposition from those sections. The exact-kernel, complete-choice, decomposition and transport theorems reused afterward have no ambient finite-dimensionality requirements, so the complete S2 conclusion survives, not merely the existence statement.

The counterexample is instantiated as actual Polynomial k and Polynomial k times k representations of the finite trivial group Unit. inclusion, quotient, alpha and beta are the specified maps; polynomial_exact_row proves injectivity, exact image/kernel and surjectivity, polynomial_commutes proves both squares, and baseSection is a real equivariant right inverse. An arbitrary coherent family forces the recurrence a_n=X*a_(n+1)+1 by evaluating at 1. no_polynomial_recurrence then forces every coefficient of a_0 to be one, contradicting finite polynomial degree in any field, including positive characteristic. Every finite prefix is actually constructed by descending a chosen last section, independently of a global family.

The constant k -> k times k -> k example satisfies the finite-dimensional data and has an explicit compatible family. shearEquiv is the actual invertible equivariant map (a,c) -> (a+v*c,c), and its inclusion, quotient and identity-transition diagrams are verified. The theorem for v=1 excludes fixedness of every possible section family, even before imposing coherence, hence rules out any globally natural choice rather than only a particular algorithm. For arbitrary finite-dimensional towers, existence comes from S2; familyEquiv/parameterEquiv and unique_family_iff give uniqueness exactly when Hom_G(C,A-infinity) is zero. This is the coherent lim W parameter space by coordinate assembly/extraction. Coherent transport is a bijection, so it preserves a unique solution when one exists. No eventual-bijective-tail assumption or W_N criterion is applied in S6.

verification_evidence.mode: Reused exact current fresh author verification; no independent recompilation

resolved_findings.initial_finding: Binary affine combination preservation alone does not characterize affine maps over F2.
resolved_findings.resolution: Actual ternary torsor operations and their preservation in both evaluation directions and in the W_N parameter chart were added, independently read and checked, and included in the final fresh verification.
